name: Tilyard Plumbing
description: Tilyard Plumbing is a locally owned plumbing business servicing Wagga Wagga and the wider Riverina, with more than 20 years in the trade and a stated focus on drainage and sewer work. Listed services include blocked drains, CCTV drain inspections, sewer renewals, stormwater, water service renewals, hot water systems, gas plumbing, maintenance, renovations and small to medium projects. Pre-purchase plumbing inspections and emergency after-hours plumbing are also offered. Service areas named on the site include Wagga Wagga, Boorooma, Gobbagombalin and North Wagga.
highlights: Blocked drains, sewer renewals and stormwater specialists
Licensed gas fitting, installations and safety checks

name: Aherns Plumbing Service
description: Aherns Plumbing Service has operated in Wagga Wagga and the surrounding region since 1994. The business is a licensed builder, plumber, drainer, roofer and gasfitter, and lists new homes, bathroom renovations and extensions, repairs and blockages, hot water services, toilet and tap repairs, roofing and guttering, pipe locating and CCTV inspections, gas fitting, sewer, stormwater and drainage, water pipe installations and septic and wastewater installation. It is also a Council-approved pressure sewer system installer. Emergency plumbing, roofing and gas fitting are advertised 24/7.
highlights: Licensed builder, plumber, drainer, roofer and gasfitter
24/7 emergency plumbing, roofing and gas fitting

name: Blair Merlehan Plumbing
description: Blair Merlehan Plumbing is a Wagga Wagga plumbing business covering emergency call-outs, blocked drains, drainage cleaning and sewage repairs. Other listed services include hot water system installation and repair for gas and electric units, gas fitting for LPG and natural gas, gas appliance installation, backflow prevention installation, servicing and water pressure testing, leak detection and water damage restoration, guttering, spouting and roofing work, stormwater management and septic tank cleaning. The site lists Wagga Wagga, Tumut and Tumbarumba as service areas and advertises 24 hour availability.
highlights: Backflow prevention installation, servicing and testing
Gas fitting for LPG and natural gas
Blocked drains, drainage cleaning and sewage repairs

name: Pertzels Plumbing
description: Pertzels Plumbing is an owner-operated plumbing business serving residential, commercial and rural clients across Wagga Wagga and the Riverina, with more than two decades of industry experience. Listed services cover maintenance, hot water systems, water leaks, roofs and gutters, gas fittings, septic systems, excavations and CCTV pipe inspections. The business runs its own excavation equipment and offers after-hours work on request.

name: Beaumont Plumbing Wagga
description: Beaumont Plumbing is a fully mobile plumbing business based at Glenfield Park and working across Wagga Wagga. Services listed include general and emergency plumbing, blocked drains, pipe relining, hot water systems, solar hot water, CCTV inspections, leak detection and gas fitting. The business is licensed under NSW Fair Trading and offers free, no-obligation quotes.
highlights: Hot water and solar hot water systems

name: Josh MacKenzie Electrical
description: Josh MacKenzie Electrical is a Wagga Wagga electrical contractor with more than 15 years of experience, working across residential, commercial and industrial jobs. Listed services include lighting design, renovations, switchboard upgrades and shift coverage for commercial clients. The business services Wagga Wagga and surrounding regions.
highlights: Residential, commercial and industrial electrical work

name: Hibbard Electrics
description: Hibbard Electrics is a Wagga Wagga electrical contractor advertising a 24/7 service across commercial, rural and residential work. Commercial services listed include connection to the grid, meter upgrades and maintenance, overhead power, underground cabling, fault finding and repair, maintenance of lights and pumps, data and fibre cabling and subcontracting. Residential and rural work covers switchboard and meter upgrades, hot water systems, lighting, ceiling fans, ovens, rangehoods and cooktops, smoke alarms and power point installation.
highlights: Grid connection, meter upgrades and overhead power
Underground and data and fibre cabling

name: D & S Taber Electrical
description: Taber Electrical is a family-owned team of licensed electricians that has serviced Wagga Wagga and the Riverina since 1981. The business covers residential and commercial electrical work along with solar installation, and publishes resources and tips on choosing an electrician in Wagga.
highlights: Servicing Wagga Wagga and the Riverina

name: Brent Hawe Solar & Electrical
description: Brent Hawe Solar & Electrical is a locally owned solar and electrical business working in Wagga Wagga and beyond. Listed services are solar installations, solar panel maintenance, solar batteries, electric vehicle charging, general electrical services and security CCTV. The site advertises a 25-year product warranty and a 5-year workmanship warranty, and covers government rebates.
highlights: Solar installation and solar panel maintenance
Solar batteries and off-grid style storage

name: Hamblin Solar
description: Hamblin Solar is a locally owned solar business based in Wagga Wagga that installs solar panel and battery storage systems for homes. The site sets out the installation process, the systems offered and how the federal Small-scale Renewable Energy Scheme (SRES) benefit applies to household and small business installations.
highlights: Solar panel and battery storage installation
Locally owned and operated in Wagga Wagga
Free quote requests through the site

name: Hurst Homes
description: Hurst Homes is a Wagga Wagga new home builder offering standard plans, house and land packages and custom designs, including energy efficient designs. The business runs a display home and a selection centre, publishes a 10 step building guide for clients and offers an obligation-free inspection of land before or after purchase. First home buyer and finance information is also provided.
highlights: New homes, house and land packages and custom designs

name: de Jong Homes
description: de Jong Homes is a Wagga Wagga home builder offering three bedroom, four plus bedroom and acreage designs along with house and land packages on lots in Wagga suburbs. The business promotes fully inclusive quotes with no hidden extras, a published list of standard inclusions and move-in ready homes.
highlights: Three bedroom, four plus bedroom and acreage designs
House and land packages in Wagga suburbs
Fully inclusive quotes with no hidden extras

name: Irons Builders
description: Irons Builders is a Wagga Wagga building company with more than 20 years in construction, working across the Riverina with a team of builders, project managers, office staff and contractors. The company specialises in insurance property repairs, school refurbishments, commercial projects, custom homes, renovations and sheds, and works with one of Australia’s largest general insurance companies. Accreditations listed include NSW Government Certified Contractor SCM0256, HIA membership and CM3 safety prequalification.
highlights: HIA member and CM3 safety prequalified

name: Rivbuild
description: Rivbuild is a licensed and insured building business based at Uranquinty that works on renovations, extensions and heritage and historic restorations in Wagga Wagga and the surrounding district. Listed work includes home renovations, home extensions, and kitchen, bathroom and laundry renovations. The site states more than 27 years of industry experience and award-winning heritage restoration work.
highlights: More than 27 years of industry experience

name: Sheathers Painting & Decorating
description: Sheathers Painting & Decorating is a Wagga Wagga painting business run by Tim and a team of about 20 painters, with a combined 60 years of experience. The team takes on repaints, commercial property work and pool painting, and hires local tradesmen and apprentices. Free quotes are offered.
highlights: Repaints, commercial property and pool painting

name: Shields Painting & Decorating
description: Shields Painting & Decorating carries out interior and exterior painting for homes and businesses in Wagga Wagga. Listed services are residential painting, commercial painting, industrial painting and coating, and heritage restoration and preservation painting. The business offers a free site inspection and quote and fixed price contracts, and also services Temora, Tumut, Gundagai and Narrandera.

name: Wagga Roof Repairs
description: Wagga Roof Repairs is a locally owned and operated roofing contractor with 25 years of roofing knowledge. Listed services are tiled roofing and repairs, rebedding and pointing of ridge capping, metal roofing and repairs, roof restoration and painting, fascia and gutter repairs and installation, and reroofing. Trading hours are listed as open 24 hours, seven days.
highlights: Rebedding and pointing of ridge capping
Fascia and gutter repair and installation

name: Essential Roofing and Plumbing
description: Essential Roofing and Plumbing is a family-owned Wagga Wagga business with over 10 years of experience covering residential roofing, re-roofing, commercial roofing and guttering and downpipes, along with residential plumbing and hot water systems. Free quotes are offered and trading hours are listed as open 24 hours, seven days.
highlights: Whole house or section guttering replacement
Residential plumbing and hot water systems

name: Complete Concreting Riverina
description: Complete Concreting Riverina is a Wagga Wagga concreting business with close to a decade of industry experience, working on residential and commercial concreting as well as council crossovers. The site notes licensed crossover installation designed to meet council requirements, and a local supplier network.
highlights: Nearly a decade of industry experience

name: JDC Concreting and Rendering
description: JDC Concreting and Rendering provides concreting and rendering for commercial, industrial, civil and residential contracts in the Wagga Wagga area. The site carries a photo gallery of completed work and published business hours.
highlights: Commercial, industrial, civil and residential contracts

name: Absolutely Plastered with Lance
description: Absolutely Plastered with Lance is a Wagga Wagga plastering business with 20 years in the industry, taking on work from small repair jobs through to large commercial projects. The site highlights commercial plastering including the Thomas Bros Toyota building in Wagga Wagga completed in 2015, and notes that the team also services towns beyond Wagga.
highlights: Small repairs through to large commercial projects
Services Wagga Wagga and surrounding towns

name: Wagga Glass & Aluminium
description: Wagga Glass and Aluminium was established in 1982 and supplies commercial and domestic glass and aluminium products. The business describes itself as the only fabricator of domestic windows and doors in Wagga Wagga that both supplies and installs, and manufactures windows, doors, shopfronts, shower screens, pool fences and balustrades.
highlights: Fabricates and installs domestic windows and doors
Shower screens, pool fences and balustrades

name: SG Glass & Aluminium
description: SG Glass & Aluminium is a Wagga Wagga glazier with more than 20 years of industry experience, cutting glass to size for residential and commercial properties. Listed products and services include security doors and screens, shading blinds, windows and doors, shower screens, splashbacks and mirrors. After-hours glass repairs are offered and trading hours are listed as 7am to 5pm every day with a 24 hour emergency service.
highlights: Glass cut to size for homes and businesses

name: PalmAir Heating & Cooling Specialists
description: PalmAir Heating & Cooling Specialists has supplied and installed heating and cooling in Wagga Wagga for over 20 years. Heating products listed include ducted gas heating, gas log fires, wood fires, gas fuelled fires and portable heaters, while cooling covers ducted reverse cycle, evaporative cooling and split systems. The business also services Temora, Tumut, Narrandera, Tumbarumba and Gundagai.
highlights: Ducted gas heating and ducted reverse cycle
Gas log fires, wood fires and portable heaters
Over 20 years in heating and cooling
Services Temora, Tumut, Narrandera, Tumbarumba and Gundagai

name: Harrison & Higgins
description: Harrison & Higgins has been Wagga Wagga’s air conditioning and heating supplier for over 40 years. The business covers heating, cooling, gas and wood fires and building work, and also offers servicing and spare parts. Free measure and quote appointments and service bookings can be made through the site.
highlights: Air conditioning and heating for over 40 years

name: Coolectrics
description: Coolectrics is a Wagga Wagga business covering refrigeration, air conditioning and electrical work, with separate contacts for commercial and project work, installation and service, and administration. The team is licensed and qualified in both air conditioning and electrical trades and holds NSW, ACT and Victorian licences.
highlights: Licensed in NSW, ACT and Victoria

name: Burgess Earthmoving
description: Burgess Earthmoving Pty Ltd is a civil earthworks and excavation contractor based on Hammond Avenue in Wagga Wagga. The company lists subdivisions, contract works, plant hire, premixed concrete, concrete pumping, and quarries and crushing, and publishes a pollution incident response plan and safety data sheets on its site.

name: Elphicks Earthmoving & Rural Fencing
description: Elphick’s Earthmoving is a Junee based contractor specialising in rural fencing built to specification, along with stock water systems, trenching and pipe laying and the installation of tanks and troughs. The business also carries out stockyard installation, upgrades, repairs and maintenance, farm earthworks, removal and clean-up, and hires out bobcats, excavators and tippers. Service areas listed include Coolamon, Marrar, Junee, Illabo, Wantabadgery, Nangus, Oura and Wagga.
highlights: Stock water systems, trenching and pipe laying

name: Wagga Directional Drilling
description: Wagga Directional Drilling is an industrial dry excavation business with over 20 years of drilling experience, serving domestic and commercial clients in Wagga Wagga and surrounding areas. Services listed include hydro vacuum excavation with an on-site waste disposal facility, trenching, zero tension plough work, cable hauling, culvert and drain cleaning, horizontal directional drilling, pipe bursting, asbestos removal and service locating.
highlights: Hydro vac excavation and waste disposal facility
Trenching, cable hauling and zero tension plough

name: Harrisons Joinery
description: Harrisons Joinery has delivered custom joinery across the Riverina for more than 40 years, working with clients on individually designed cabinetry rather than off-the-shelf solutions. As a licensed builder the business also provides complete home renovation services. The site carries a project gallery and an online booking form.
highlights: More than 40 years in the Riverina
Licensed builder offering full home renovations

name: Kreuzer Cabinets
description: Kreuzer Cabinets is a cabinet making business with a showroom on Fernleigh Road in Wagga Wagga. Work listed includes custom cabinets, bathroom vanity cabinets, laundry cabinets, wardrobes, kitchen renovations, commercial fitouts and custom joinery. Free quotes are offered and the business also services Temora, Tumut, Gundagai, Albury and Cootamundra.
highlights: Also services Temora, Tumut, Gundagai, Albury and Cootamundra

name: Riverina Gate & Fencing Solutions
description: Riverina Gate & Fencing Solutions supplies and installs gates and fencing in Wagga Wagga. Products listed include aluminium pool fences, aluminium slats and screens, chainwire fencing, glass pool fencing, balustrade, PVC fencing and security fencing, together with a fencing installation service. Saturday appointments are available by arrangement.

name: Parr's Fencing
description: Parr’s Fencing is a husband and wife rural fencing team based at Coolamon that builds fencing for farms and agricultural properties, including livestock containment and boundary fencing. While based in Coolamon the business states it works across New South Wales, and offers obligation-free quotes.

name: Sheds By Design
description: Sheds By Design supplies bolted sheds for Wagga Wagga and surrounding areas of New South Wales. The range listed includes garages and garaports, rural sheds, barns, industrial sheds, skillion monoslope sheds, stud frame buildings, gable and skillion carports and patios. The business works with licensed builders who can also arrange erection and a concrete slab, and publishes a colour chart and sheeting guide.
highlights: Rural sheds, barns and industrial sheds
Erection and concrete slab can be arranged
Colour chart and sheeting guide online

name: RivSteel Wagga Sheds & Trailers
description: RivSteel is a Sturt Highway business at Gumly Gumly, just east of Wagga Wagga, selling Australian made sheds and a large range of custom trailers. The trailer range includes single and tandem axle, hot dipped galvanised, motorbike, tradesman, enclosed, car, hydraulic tipper, plant, flat top, skel and stock trailers. Sheds, warranty details, finance and a downloadable catalogue are also on the site.
highlights: Hot dipped galvanised and tipper trailers

name: Creative Outdoors & More
description: Creative Outdoors & More is a Wagga Wagga landscaping business that designs and builds outdoor spaces for councils, schools, businesses, childcare centres, public parks and retirement villages, working throughout the Riverina and southern New South Wales. Project types listed include outdoor learning spaces, community parks, aged care, higher education and civil work. The business also sells concrete sleepers through an online shop.
highlights: Outdoor learning spaces and community parks
Aged care and higher education projects
